# Vision UI is locked permanently

HARD STOP. Do not change, restyle, recolor, modernize, or delete CineMind
Vision UI. This applies to Cursor, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, and
any other coding agent.

If you are ChatGPT in a browser **without this repository attached**, you
still must not invent a new theme. Ask Gilbert to attach `AGENTS.md` or
this repo. Never replace gold glass with cool slate / rose / cyan.

## Frozen files (do not edit)

- `frontend/src/index.css`
- `frontend/src/App.css`
- `frontend/tailwind.config.js`
- `frontend/public/index.html` background and color

Run `python3 scripts/check_vision_ui_lock.py` after UI work. If it fails,
revert the theme files.
